title: PASTA: Prompt-Aware Annealed Diffusion Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.32390v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While Diffusion models produce high-quality images, real-world visual design requires intentionally preserving clean regions for headlines, logos, or UI elements. Existing layout-aware text-to-image methods struggle to strictly preserve reserved regions, often introducing unwanted content that complicates downstream editing. Existing approaches either manipulate attention to displace content or suppress conditioning via noise-level interventions. However, these methods sacrifice visual coherence, producing flat regions or noticeable style inconsistencies between reserved and non-reserved areas. To address this limitation, we propose a Prompt-Aware Shared-Latent Training-Free Annealed Diffusion Sampling (PASTA), a training-free framework that enforces reserved-region constraints by selectively applying semantic guidance to object-allowed regions during sampling. translated_title: PASTA：提示感知的退火扩散采样
translated_abstract: 尽管扩散模型能够生成高质量的图像，但现实世界的视觉设计需要有意识地保留干净区域，用于放置标题、标志或UI元素。现有的布局感知文本到图像方法难以严格保留预留区域，常常引入不必要的内容，使下游编辑变得复杂。现有方法要么通过操纵注意力机制来移除内容，要么通过噪声级干预来抑制条件控制。然而，这些方法牺牲了视觉连贯性，会在预留区域和非预留区域之间产生平淡的区域或明显的风格不一致。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了提示感知共享潜变量免训练退火扩散采样（PASTA），这是一个免训练框架，通过在采样过程中选择性地向允许放置对象的区域应用语义引导，来强制执行预留区域约束。PASTA在共享潜变量轨迹上运行，其中完整提示与上下文……
tldr: PASTA提出了一种免训练的提示感知退火扩散采样框架，通过在共享潜变量轨迹上对允许对象的区域选择性施加语义引导，在文本到图像生成中严格保留指定区域，同时保持视觉连贯性。
en_tdlr: PASTA is a training-free, prompt-aware annealed diffusion sampling framework that strictly preserves reserved regions in text-to-image generation by selectively applying semantic guidance to object-allowed regions on a shared latent trajectory, without sacrificing visual coherence.
